Membership denial invariants compare live REST memberCount/founder/modes and role definitions, plus account_roles/channel_user_roles SQLite emptiness. They do not deep-compare every session attachment or every ChanServ ACL table.

HistServ DELETE/FORGET, operator RELAYMSG/roleplay/multiline producers, inbound/outbound webhooks, every legacy/admin message alias, cross-shard recipients and DM mutation scope are not exhaustively exercised by this messaging slice; dedicated service/DM/race slices must be consulted for their actual coverage.

evidence.testTitle: MSG-027: disabled authority is rechecked on surviving sockets despite lost invalidation delivery
evidence.scenarioScope: Disabled-account authority is checked independently of eager socket closure, for continuously live and hibernated surviving connections.
evidence.rationale: Exact execution match; frozen05 failures remain historical proof and frozen06 success establishes the selected final behavior.
assertionDetails: All users and rootadmin are provisioned through genuine public registration/bootstrap/login on the frozen production runtime with unique passwords; original credentials and SQLite directory are reused by a copied-bundle Miniflare fixture.

The fixture subclasses only SessionDO.invalidateAccountPermissions to return 0, modeling lost eager invalidation delivery after Accounts committed disable; no authentication, dispatch, ingress, outbound permission checks, account storage or WebSocket attachment is overridden or fabricated.

Two independently authenticated Bob IRC sessions successfully publish/receive before disable, actual Bob event stream receives the control, Charlie admin disable is exactly 403, and genuine root disable is exactly 200 with ok=true and invalidatedSessions=0.

Both original Bob sockets are unconditionally asserted OPEN after committed disable; the original sender unconditionally sends PRIVMSG disabled-surviving-socket-publish and the unchanged production ingress check closes it with code 1000/reason Account no longer available.

Existing Bob REST append is exactly 401; Alice private post still reaches authorized IRC/event recipients, while Bob receiver/event stream and unrelated Charlie IRC/event stream receive no private content and no stream receives forbidden publish content.

A second device can remain open after account-wide membership cleanup; if still OPEN its next PING triggers the unchanged credential recheck and closure, rather than assuming membership removal always immediately closes every socket.

After actual fixture disposal, SQLite contains no disabled IRC/REST publish, retains original/unrelated/Alice-new message authors and bodies, stores Bob disabled_at with Alice enabled, preserves root admin role and empty Bob/custom-channel role assignments; a new uninstrumented production runtime keeps Bob REST at 401 and retains legitimate/unrelated history.
